spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_takedown.name: Takedown
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_takedown.descr: Bare-handed, at your lock-on foe (or the one in your sights). Time Flow: at 8 combo time stops round him for a beatdown and he's left downed; at 16 the nearest other goes down too. Web: at 8 of your hit streak he's webbed and slammed down (two at 16); from a perch above him, he's strung up.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_blink.name: Shadow Blink
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_blink.descript: Time Flow, 3 combo. At a foe you've hit with something thrown or shot: you blink to his back and strike.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_finish.name: Finish
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_finish.descrip: Web. A downed foe: one of the symbiote's executions while suited, or with 3 or more in your hit streak a quick finish that counts on.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_counter.name: Counter
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_counter.descri: Web. Just after a Spider-Sense dodge: strike back at whoever came at you.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_fists.name: Webbed Fists
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_fists.descript: Web, without the symbiote. Coat your fists in web: punches stick and slow, the third cocoons.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_arm.name: Weapon Arm
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_arm.descriptio: Symbiote. The arm forms a weapon and strikes at your foe.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_grab.name: Grab
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_grab.descripti: Symbiote. Seize a foe up to a cow's size in your hand; holding one, maul it; tendrils full, a combo.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_tendril.name: Tendril Grab
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_tendril.descri: Symbiote. A tendril snatches what you're looking at, as from the X menu.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_spikes.name: Spike Burst
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_spikes.descrip: Symbiote. Spikes out of every part of you at once (in the big suit, a roar), as from the X menu.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_consume.name: Consume
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_consume.descri: Symbiote. It feeds on a corpse, as from the X menu.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_shroud.name: Shroud
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_shroud.descrip: Symbiote. You go unseen until you strike, as from the X menu.
